---
title: "Batch stored file lookups by the adapter's parameter limit"
description: "Drop when the pinned release keeps the stored file reference lookup within D1's limit of 100 bound parameters."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.3. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

Deleting an upload with many image variants fails on D1 with "D1_ERROR: too
many SQL variables". Before Payload removes an upload's files, it looks for
documents that still reference them. One query binds every candidate name
once for each filename column: the file, its original, and each variant. The
candidates include every suffix of each storage key, and a cloud storage key
is \<objectKey>/\<filename>, so seven variants bind 144 parameters. D1 accepts
100. D1 has no transactions, so the document stays deleted, the API returns
an error, and the files stay in storage. Replacing a file runs the same
lookup.

BaseDatabaseAdapter now declares limitedBoundParameters, which the D1 adapter
already sets. With it, the lookup splits the names into batches that keep each
query within 100 bound parameters. Other adapters keep batches of 100 names.

- **Patch:** `d1-file-lookup-bound-parameters`, committed as `fix(payload): batch stored file lookups by the adapter's parameter limit`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `e2e suite (media update and delete test)`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0005-fix-payload-batch-stored-file-lookups-by-the-adapter.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0005-fix-payload-batch-stored-file-lookups-by-the-adapter.patch)
